comment: Huff is a really chill and engaging professor who knows his stuff. I honestly really liked going to his class. The first test isn't too bad, the second test is pretty hard, and the final is somewhere in the middle. There's weekly homework but it isn't too hard or time consuming. Study and you should be able to get an A.
FAVORITE. TEACHER. EVER. Seriously, I love this guy. I bet his family is awesome too, because he's the man.

Horrible professor. Did not actually explain the homework, but instead just put the answers up on the board and that was your typical teaching from him.  Must learn absolutely everything by yourself.  Great guy, great accountant, HORRIBLE professor.

SO MUCH HOMEWORK! You teach yourself the material. the first test isn't bad but the second and third are pretty brutal, the multiple choice is the hardest part. Definitely not bad if you do the homework every night but it is hard to finish all that he gives you

Not necessarily an easy A, you will get out of it what you put into it. LOTS of homework, but that's really how you learn accounting. Great final exam policy-90 or above average on 3 tests and you're exempt--that's not to say getting a 90 is easy, it's not. I studied for the second test for 18 hours and didn't even get an A. Worthwhile professor.
This dude is funny! His jokes are weird, but I enjoyed him. Pretty good teacher though, I'd be happy to have him again.
Nice guy but his teaching methods are not the best. Quite easy class overall.
